We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager - 
Location: Chennai
Experience: 6+ years
Employment: Full-time

About the company
We’re hiring for an AI-native cybersecurity company building products that help organizations identify, prioritize, and act on their most critical security risks.

About the role
We are looking for a strategic and execution-focused Product Manager to own key product initiatives from customer discovery and ideation through launch and iteration.
You will work closely with engineering, design, go-to-market teams, customers, and executive leadership to define product strategy, build roadmaps, prioritize features, and deliver products that create measurable customer and business impact.
This is an individual contributor role with significant ownership and influence. You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, handling ambiguity, making data-driven decisions, and influencing cross-functional teams without direct authority.
The role also requires strong technical fluency and an understanding of emerging technologies such as GenAI and LLMs, particularly in cybersecurity contexts.

What we’re looking for
• 6+ years of Product Management experience
• Strong B2B SaaS / technology product experience
• Experience owning products/features end-to-end
• Strong product strategy, roadmap & prioritization skills
• Strong technical fluency and experience working with engineering teams
• Data-driven approach to product decisions
• Experience in cybersecurity is a strong plus
• Understanding of GenAI / LLMs
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
• Strong ownership and ability to influence without authority

If you're a Product Manager who thrives on ownership, moves fast, and loves building products at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, we'd love to hear from you.
